question.text: The seven types of margins in commodity futures are:

answer.text: Initial, ELM, mark-to-market, special/additional, concentration, lean period, and tender/delivery period margin
Only initial margin and MTM margin
Initial, maintenance, and variation margin only

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists seven futures-segment margins: initial margin, extreme loss margin, mark-to-market margin, special/additional margin, concentration margin, lean period margin, and tender/delivery period margin. The Trap: There are seven types, not just two or three. SPAN is the methodology used to compute initial margin, not a separate margin type on its own. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels removed; the seven-margin list retained with neutral wording.
